manualChecks.procedure: Dictate short and long text with the Windows default microphone; verify visible listening state, insertion, and device release after stop.
Repeat after changing the default input device and after unplugging the active device; verify a truthful error and no stuck microphone.
Deny Windows microphone permission, start dictation, and verify no capture begins, the error explains the privacy state, and retry works after permission is restored.
Cancel during model preparation and immediately after microphone start; verify no late listening state, insertion, or retained device handle.
Interrupt an active utterance after a visible partial; verify the best recoverable text is offered without false final-success copy.
Dictate at the cursor, then replace the clipboard before restore; verify Octadock restores only when its own write is still current.
Record short and long samples for supported English accents and at least one configured fallback language; retain transcript and timing evidence.
